findings.title: Since the RG1 slips table, the product e2e suite fails deterministically in chromium-ar: p3-prioritization-roadmap's auditor test reads the Arabic sort header 'الاعتمادية' (dependency) as an 'اعتماد' (approve) write control
findings.reproduction: Candidate sha256:5df44203... (source edbf5ce), disposable clone, real stack (apps/web/e2e/support/with-stack.sh, AUTH_MODE=dev), --workers=1. Run the full product e2e (npx playwright test apps/web/e2e) in either locale setting, or the spec alone (npx playwright test apps/web/e2e/p3-prioritization-roadmap.spec.ts). Test ':542 the read-only auditor: prioritization, roadmap and dependencies show data with no enabled write control' fails in chromium-ar at its last assertion, expect(page.locator('main#main').getByRole('button', { name: /approve|اعتماد|move|نقل/i })).toHaveCount(0) (spec line ~502): 'Expected: 0, Received: 1'. The one match is on /transformations/<id>/dependencies: the column-sort header button 'الاعتمادية غير مرتّب' ('Dependency, not sorted') of the 'تأخّرات الاعتماديات الحرجة' (critical dependency slips) table. T-DG5-FE-RG1 (F-DG5-120; apps/web/src/pages/dependencies/slips.tsx, merge 5474a66) added that table to the Dependencies page. The catalogue key dependencies.slips.col.dependency (apps/web/src/i18n/ar/dependencies.json) ='الاعتمادية' contains the substring 'اعتماد'. Because the spec is serial, ':569 capacity screen ...' then does not run in chromium-ar. chromium-en passes ('Dependency' matches neither 'approve' nor 'move'). The spec is unchanged since DG3 (f805130); round 1 (candidate 8df7f922, before RG1) passed it. The orchestrator's D-186 verification skipped the e2e runs (disclosed), so the merged tree never ran it.
findings.expected: The candidate's own product e2e suite passes on the real stack in chromium-en and chromium-ar. The auditor read-only test keeps its intent (no enabled approve/move write control for AUD on the three screens) without treating a read-only column-sort control whose Arabic label contains the letters of 'اعتماد' as a write control (for example, by excluding sort headers, as the round-1/2 qa AUD sweep does, or by matching whole words or exact catalogue labels). Alternatively, the new table's label is chosen so that it does not collide, if the frontend owner prefers.
findings.actual: Locale unset: 465 passed, 2 failed, 3 did not run (this test is one of the 2; the other is F-DG5-144). C.UTF-8: 468 passed, 1 failed (this test), 1 did not run (:569 capacity, ar). Alone: 12 passed, 1 failed (this test), 1 did not run. The PRODUCT is correct. The matched button is a read-only sort control inside a th. The page shows the auditor the read-only note. My AUD sweep of the same Dependencies page (zz-qa-dg5rg2-aud-p5.spec.ts) records 0 mutating requests and 0 enabled write controls in en and ar. So there is no authorization or data effect (not mandatory). The defect is that a required check of this gate, the product journey e2e suite, cannot pass on the frozen candidate. The chromium-ar coverage of the auditor's read-only assertions on these three screens, and the stubbed capacity test, is lost until it is repaired. Medium: a material defect of limited scope that a re-freeze must fix; per D-185 a Medium finding cannot be accepted as an observation.

findings.title: p4-raid-governance.spec.ts test 5 (meeting workspace) runs on the default 30 s budget and timed out in chromium-ar in the full product suite (the F-DG5-141 class in another test)
findings.reproduction: Full product e2e on the real stack, --workers=1, locale unset (scripts/run-e2e.sh unset ... product apps/web/e2e). Test 396 [chromium-ar] apps/web/e2e/p4-raid-governance.spec.ts:290 '5. Meeting workspace: an incomplete executive ask is refused, then published to T16 and decided in session' failed with 'Test timeout of 30000ms exceeded' (30.1 s) at a 1-minute load of about 7-8.5. No assertion failed, and the trace has no step above 1.8 s: it is a long chain of steps. Its serial followers 6 and 7 (the auditor's read-only views, and 390 px / 200 % text) then did not run in chromium-ar. The test sets no explicit timeout. Measured durations: this round, unset en 27.2 s, ar 30.1 s (timeout); C.UTF-8 en 16.0 s, ar 25.0 s; alone at load ~3, 16.9 s and 16.5 s (14/14). Round 1: 22.7 s / 27.8 s and 17.4 s / 21.6 s.
findings.expected: As for p4-dashboards test 6 (F-DG5-141), the p2 journeys (earlier DG5 history) and p4-gates-closure test 9 (D-173): the test has an explicit budget with at least 2x headroom over a measured loaded case, so a full-suite run does not exceed it. Its assertions are unchanged.
findings.actual: Under the default 30 s budget the chromium-ar run has almost no headroom (25-30 s in the full suite), so the required product e2e check fails intermittently with no product defect. The product behaviour is correct: the spec passes 14/14 alone and passed in the C.UTF-8 full run. Low and not mandatory: no data, calculation, access-control or portability effect.
